column3: Expand the architecture-drift comparison beyond lte-workstation to at least three independent external repositories selected by preregistered criteria; freeze revisions, licenses, acquisition hashes, source manifests, and comparable snapshot windows, recording unavailable inputs explicitly.

Run the same structural, lexical, behavioral, and generative protocol over the frozen independent-repository sample; retain raw inputs/outputs, prompts, seeds, model/scorer digests, uncertainty, commands, and per-repository PASS/OPEN/BLOCKED predicates without promoting unsupported headlines.

Rewrite the repository-local architecture-drift conclusions for a non-specialist reader: state the question, data, actual comparison, supported findings, unsupported claims, limitations, and exact reproducibility path; link every headline number to a retained artifact and distinguish our repository's longitudinal drift from cross-repository evidence.

Independently review the completed architecture-drift package and reader-facing conclusions for sample validity, provenance, statistical/semantic overclaiming, reproducibility, clarity, and unresolved obligations; publish comments and create explicit corrective successor tasks where needed. Do not review as the producing owner.
